Same block as before, still unresolved: `rdkit.featurize` won't accept `id_column`/`smiles_column` (dataset uses `canonical_smiles`) and `ml.train` only allows `logreg|rf`, so xgboost can't be chosen.

The worker prepared a small patch (`runs/registry.patch`: two optional fields + one enum value in `src/research/registry.ts`). Do you want to apply it yourself, or authorize the worker to patch that file while you handle the rebuild and restart?
